name: RC-B10-0415/2025 – After § 5 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text: 5a.Stresses that the degrading humanitarian situation in Afghanistan will increase migratory pressure on Europe; recalls that Afghan asylum seekers are overwhelmingly male and are overrepresented in crime rates in several European countries; considers, therefore, that the humanitarian response should be delivered directly in Afghanistan and should in no way consist of welcoming more Afghans to the EU;
